relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Controlled sharing of requirements, evidence and feedback.

relations.name: Sponsor learning investment
relations.description: The sponsor provides a business constraint and a bounded investment mandate; L&D returns outcome evidence.

relations.name: Commission learning operations
relations.description: L&D defines priorities; administration owns configured delivery and qualification workflows.

relations.name: Agree role priorities
relations.description: Role owners review required capabilities and make development time available.

relations.name: Support learning and practice
relations.description: The manager agrees goals and practice time while the employee participates and supplies evidence.

relations.name: Review progress and disputes
relations.description: Employees share work evidence and may challenge inaccurate assessments; managers must record their decisions.

relations.name: Commission reviewed learning
relations.description: Administrators provide audience and policy context; authors provide approved content and revision decisions.

relations.name: Request external training
relations.description: The employer-side administrator coordinates approved bookings and provider commitments.

relations.name: Reconcile delivery and charges
relations.description: The provider supplies attendance and invoice or credit evidence through the contracted route.

relations.name: Delegate budget authority
relations.description: The sponsor establishes spending authority and receives commitment and exception information.

relations.name: Maintain workforce data boundaries
relations.description: IT provides reconciliation and access-change information needed to administer the correct population.

relations.name: Define authoring processing scope
relations.description: IT communicates the approved data and processor scope; authors retain responsibility for source authorization.

relations.name: Correct learning evidence
relations.description: Learners report missing records; administrators review and correct status with an audit trail.
